rows.grounds: present passive participle describing one undergoing cutting
optative expressing potential or hypothetical non-injury
compound indicating one who has reached that state
compound indicating one whose mind is absorbed in that
comparative particle introducing the manner of immunity

items.question: Can absorption in that state prevent injury when the body is being cut?
premises: A person may be physically subjected to cutting.
A person can be gone to that state.
A person can have the mind fixed on that state.
items.inference: One who has reached that state and whose mind is fixed on it, though being cut, is not truly cut.
uncertainties: The referent of 'that' depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: Just as one who has gone to that and whose mind is fixed on that, even while being cut, is not cut.
